prompt:

Preserve exact apple, mask, tail stripes, colors and head/body proportions. Do not lengthen into human legs, add armor/clothes/weapons or change animal species.
PORTRAIT transparent RGBA atlas1024x1536. EXACTLY ONE COLUMN and SIX ROWS, one separate complete whole character in each equal256px-high row. ALL SIX face EAST, directly screen RIGHT in the SAME side camera; do not turn through different directions. Every whole body including apple/leaf, tail tip and all paws fits within the CENTRAL HALF of its row height (at most128px tall), with very large transparent gutters above/below and all edges. Six bodies total, do not crop the last row. One narrow column at horizontal centre, no labels/grid or stray decorations.
Chronological grounded WALK, actual stubby hip-knee-ankle-paw articulation and small counter-swinging arms/tail, NOT six copied bobbing stills:

ROW4 CONTACT-B opposite true support: FAR smaller paw now leads RIGHT, NEAR foreground paw trails LEFT. Preserve limb depth rather than repeat row1 arrangement.
ROW5 DOWN-B weight settles onto far front-right leg with knee flex, near rear-left heel rises. Near arm swings forward and far arm back in modest counter-swing.
ROW6 PASS-B far paw supports under belly, near knee/paw lifts and swings forward RIGHT in foreground, boot/paw raised clearly above floor, near thigh occludes far thigh at hip. Next phase returns to row1 near-paw contact.
Short natural animal walking steps, small real weight transfer; head/apple scale stable, tail follows gently with continuous attachment, both feet never disappear into belly or tail. No whole-frame bounce/stretch substitute, no jump/run. Apple and leaves touch character, no detached spark/particle, mist, aura, red outline noise, ground/shadow, text, other bodies or opaque background. Six cleanly separated full sprites with exceptionally broad transparent vertical gutters.
